source.limitation: The paper names AMBIANCE-IMPLEMENTATION.md and reference tests but supplies no repository URL or commit. Those implementations and reported results have not been independently reproduced.

scope: Track published single-principal, single-site semantics and Cosmos product acceptance. Cosmos and Center use the paper's self-hosted LiveKit substrate for text coordination; native clients, media and full acceptance remain unfinished. This inventory is not a passing conformance report.
verificationPolicy: pending means no implementation evidence is recorded; partial means a cited implementation or test definition covers only part of the requirement. Evidence references and metadata checks never establish that behavior passed, physical acceptance occurred, or production is conformant. Runtime reports and secrets stay outside the checkout.

interpretations.decision: The formal occupancy rule excludes higher-class content from every channel in occupied or unknown rooms, while headset scenarios suggest an exception. Pending an explicit policy decision, new routing must fail closed; a private headset is not an implicit exemption.

A private output does not authorize sensitive memory retrieval for a shared-origin request. Require a new authorized private-origin continuation rather than importing private memory to satisfy the shared-microphone example.

Exact runtime outcomes can gate controlled expressions and action templates. Arbitrary model prose is not proven universally outcome-truthful, in either native audio or generated-text TTS; invariant 10 remains unverified.

evidence.scope: Defines real local SFU delivery through authenticated room membership and the durable runtime; network receipt stays separate from sequenced render acknowledgment and hide-to-clear behavior.
evidence.limitation: Synthetic Rust surface and localhost SFU only. Center DOM, deployment, media and physical clients remain outstanding.

evidence.scope: Defines atomic state and sequence admission, transaction rollback, competing pools, reopen and committed delivery notification.
evidence.limitation: Requires isolated PostgreSQL; does not establish physical visibility, media state or live deployment.

evidence.scope: Defines a localhost LiveKit RPC exchange through the actual Rust adapter, requiring server-attributed caller identity, bounded payloads and explicit disconnect state.
evidence.limitation: Requires synthetic room tokens and an isolated server. Adapter test definition only; application enrollment, role-specific media access, Center integration and physical Pin behavior remain outstanding.

evidence.scope: Defines epoch/incarnation-bound browser input whose exact replay cannot start cognition again and whose changed text is rejected before cognition.
evidence.limitation: Runtime entry-point definition only. Existing HTTP ingress has not yet been replaced by the application room adapter; cancellation, acknowledgment and state sequence bindings remain required.

evidence.scope: Defines failed event append rolling back the input cursor and turn together, competing PostgreSQL workers producing one admission, durable reopen returning the prior admission, and revocation denying replay.
evidence.limitation: Requires isolated PostgreSQL; definition only. Does not establish database-server restart, all coordination messages, countersigned audit anchors or device boot attestation.

evidence.scope: Defines one typed larger-model analysis of the admitted current request, rejecting private egress, tool execution, malformed output and service privacy downgrades without saved-data access.
evidence.limitation: Test definition only. Tool-free HTTP analysis supports the selected OpenAI-compatible provider; Codex analysis, authorized memory retrieval and other semantic services remain outstanding. Conservative text checks are not universal classification.

evidence.scope: Defines current-origin revalidation dropping a pending analysis future on Pin revocation before its result arrives; the analyzer receives no tools or Store.
evidence.limitation: In-memory test definition, not live provider cancellation or billing evidence; physical audio interruption and the realtime media substrate remain outstanding.

evidence.scope: Defines an isolated PostgreSQL service-start append failure rolling back authorization, one-use admission across reopen, ordered content-free service events and result privacy gating before dispatch.
evidence.limitation: Requires an isolated database; definition only, not a passing execution report. Does not prove independent anchors, complete audit views or database-server restart behavior.

evidence.scope: Removes the legacy browser-to-Pin control, simulated device, raw trace and arbitrary speech paths; existing authenticated browser routes return bounded unavailable responses without model, tool or private-store access.
evidence.limitation: Legacy browser routes remain unavailable; the separate approved-browser runtime ingress has bounded text and render support. Realtime substrate and replacement production evaluator remain required before deployment.

evidence.scope: Requires typed authenticated device provenance, current pairing ownership and the active fixed-profile Pin binding in the shared registry before stock assistant admission; long-lived messages recheck the same boundary.
evidence.limitation: Admission establishes transport and approval only. Current stock text now converges on the durable runtime; actor authentication, private-origin clearance and hardware boot epoch/sequence remain unimplemented. Separate runtime tests define the cancellation and dispatch-time slices.

evidence.scope: Defines owner-approved shared speech, unknown actor/occupancy, class-zero cognition and no hints/reflexes within the existing registry; browser credentials cannot update a Pin binding.
evidence.limitation: The stock Respond-to-TTS seam is known but rendering/playback, secure input, epoch/sequence, laser and haptic behavior are not established by this profile. The combined registry cap remains 16 approvals.

evidence.limitation: Test definition only, not an execution report. No checkpoint anchors, complete decision ledger, provider or physical Pin acceptance.

evidence.scope: Retains authenticated device provenance alongside the account identity at ingress before account normalization.
evidence.limitation: Definition only, not executed acceptance. Does not establish enrollment, physical privacy, epochs, replay protection or complete invariant coverage.

Asserts zero private-store access and no device/account identifiers in model context.
evidence.limitation: Test definition only, not a passing execution report or physical Pin evidence. Does not establish physical privacy, hardware epochs, replay protection, realtime audio or complete invariant coverage.

evidence.limitation: A fixed shared visual profile with bounded text input/render support does not establish private physical posture, earned authority or realtime/native participation.

evidence.limitation: Test definition only, not an execution report. Covers the browser enrollment HTTP boundary, not all surface transports, runtime dispatch or complete invariant coverage.

evidence.scope: Defines a PostgreSQL registry transition whose event-append failure must roll back surface state and its per-principal chain head together.
evidence.limitation: Test definition only, not an execution report. Registry mutations only, not routing or all policy decisions; no independent anchors, retention, privacy-filtered audit views or database-server restart evidence.

evidence.scope: Defines a same-key retry and logged fallback lineage whose exact replacement acknowledgment permits controlled confirmation; the original unknown outcome alone does not.
evidence.limitation: Definition only; no consequential side effects, real network partitions, independent anchors or hardware playback.

evidence.scope: Defines encrypted output disconnection cancelling blocked cognition and pending display wait, releasing only the pending durable turn.
evidence.limitation: Definition only, not a passing report. Transport replacement is not authenticated speaker correction; audio interruption and hardware cancellation remain unverified.

evidence.scope: Defines isolated PostgreSQL competing workers, failed append rollback, durable reopen and registry-revocation fencing for runtime decisions.
evidence.limitation: Requires an isolated test database and is not an execution report. No production database effects, database-server restart proof, signed checkpoints or independent anchors.

requirements.requirement: Dispatch-time channel eligibility forbids above-shared_room content on bystander-perceivable outputs and cancels in-flight delivery after privacy degradation.
requirements.acceptance: Exercise every render path with state changes before and during dispatch; include local playback stop and already-rendered-content limitations.

requirements.requirement: Removing every hint leaves routing safe; hints affect eligible-candidate ranking only.
requirements.acceptance: Run paired hint/no-hint cases, including untrusted hints, self-nomination, hint budgets and claimed privacy downgrades.

requirements.requirement: Always-confirm effects require a logged, unexpired, single-use grant for the exact action instance.
requirements.acceptance: Bind deterministic ceremony content, arguments, target and epoch; reject changed actions, replay, expiry and restart. Existing conversational confirmation alone is not this grant protocol.

requirements.requirement: A shared-origin request cannot receive sensitive-scoped memory in model context.
requirements.acceptance: Check retrieval before every inference and delegation; selecting a private rendering channel must not broaden origin authority.

requirements.requirement: Routing and policy decisions retain rationale in a verifiable, tamper-evident durable history.
requirements.acceptance: Verify append-before-dispatch, ordering, reopen, tamper/removal detection, signed checkpoints and independently countersigned or protected checkpoint anchors.

requirements.requirement: Runtime classification retains the strongest provenance restriction; cognition may tighten it but cannot lower it.
requirements.acceptance: Join origin, memory and service-data classes across async work, hints, retries and output; log any authorized deterministic reclassification.

requirements.requirement: Shared expression does not reveal whether routing elsewhere was caused by privacy or ordinary eligibility/preference.
requirements.acceptance: Compare observable expression traces, including direct expression requests; private-only status never leaks to a shared LED or loudspeaker.

requirements.requirement: Unenrolled actors' biometric features remain turn-local and never enter durable storage or memory.
requirements.acceptance: Test ingestion, logs, memory, providers and real sensor-buffer lifecycle. The paper's durable-path tests do not establish physical buffer ephemerality.

requirements.requirement: Co-hosting a surface with Cosmos supplies no routing privilege over an equivalent remote surface.
requirements.acceptance: Compare equivalent manifests, provenance and state through actual in-process and remote ingress, not only renamed fixture identities.

requirements.requirement: Spoken and expressive outcome claims require the matching committed runtime outcome.
requirements.acceptance: Require the exact action's acknowledgment, reject stale/unrelated acknowledgments, represent unknown outcomes honestly, and resolve unrestricted-outcome-prose before claiming universal coverage.

requirements.requirement: Other principals cannot read request content or intent transcripts without a recorded disclosure.
requirements.acceptance: Verify principal-scoped observer projections, allowlisted operator telemetry, logged disclosure and authenticated redaction tombstones across storage and mirrors.

requirements.requirement: A newly present, unenrolled device gains neither private content nor hint admission from favorable self-declarations.
requirements.acceptance: Exercise admission, re-enrollment, manifest updates and revocation; default to shared-perceivable, class zero, no hints and no lead eligibility.

requirements.requirement: Declare capabilities, constraints, per-channel posture, expression, cognition and bounded authority; enrollment attests asserted posture and registry-owned trust is separate.
requirements.acceptance: Validate dynamic state and capabilities without product-name privileges; expression eligibility respects the user's perceptual profile and has one expression lead.

requirements.requirement: Bind each request to authenticated principal, origin, modality, state, environment, device/channel/actor trust, server receipt time, epoch and sequence.
requirements.acceptance: Preserve Pin device identity before account normalization; do not trust device clocks or body-supplied identity, and test replay/freshness plus scoped self-echo rejection.

requirements.requirement: Cognition proposes runtime intents; only deterministic runtime policy binds targets, grants, memory scope and dispatch, including policy/registry changes.
requirements.acceptance: Keep asynchronous analysis responsive to cancellation without granting analytical models direct device or service execution authority.

requirements.requirement: Inference offers declare supported tasks and representations, provider location and privacy eligibility independently of device permission.
requirements.acceptance: Select eligible local or remote analysis routes under availability/resource budgets; a better model declaration must not grant additional authority.

requirements.requirement: Per-surface autonomy depends on calibration, counterfactual lift, coverage and tenure/volume, with per-intent promotion, demotion and a platform-trust ceiling.
requirements.acceptance: Keep privacy and always-confirm policy nondelegable; restrict delegation to none/low risk, audit local outcomes and measure local-resolution rate. Software/prompt candidate promotion is a separate evaluation.

requirements.requirement: Serialize authority per authenticated principal, corroborate duplicate capture within that principal and allow only authorized corrections to supersede remaining work.
requirements.acceptance: Race distinct surfaces, guests, corrections and slow model results; stale work cannot dispatch or produce a terminal expression for a superseded turn.

requirements.requirement: Durable recovery and receiver dedup preserve action identity; render repair uses revalidated logged fallbacks, while uncertain effects never retry automatically.
requirements.acceptance: Exercise crashes around commit/dispatch/ack, partitions, reconnect and bounded offline queues; invalidate grants on restart and require fresh ceremony after outcome unknown.

requirements.requirement: Durable memory and learned preferences are scoped, policy-gated, attributable, visible and deletable; one correction cannot silently become standing policy.
requirements.acceptance: Test sensitive-write confirmation, principal/device/class/room/workflow/session scope, retention/redaction and explicit or repeated preference learning.

requirements.requirement: Large-content references authorize only the channels selected by the runtime, with authorization checked when dereferenced.
requirements.acceptance: Suppressed, revoked or stale recipients cannot fetch content via shared transport, cache, observer or reference; possession alone is insufficient.

requirements.requirement: Measure expression under 200 ms, durable routing p50 under 50 ms and voice-to-first-action p50 under 2.5 s; dispatch timeouts, not heartbeat expiry, drive repair.
requirements.acceptance: Publish stage/model/hardware context, 50-surface scale, baseline and hint/scorer ablations; evaluate longitudinal quality, accessibility and user/bystander hypotheses without treating them as established facts.

requirements.requirement: The Ai Pin participates in the live capture, cognition, playback and interruption loop through its stock-compatible runtime.
requirements.acceptance: Prove actual capture/playback ownership, audio focus, barge-in, immediate stop, privacy change and reconnect on hardware; completed-text TTS is not proof of live dialogue.

requirements.requirement: A physical Pin demonstrates the canonical interaction and counterfactuals against the exact installed runtime and server release.
requirements.acceptance: With exact serial and explicit device confirmation, observe microphone, speaker, gestures, privacy suppression, render acknowledgment and interruption; synthetic traces cannot replace human/device evidence.

requirements.requirement: Center is a registered rendering surface separately from its read-only observer role, providing the first two-surface Pin-to-browser interaction.
requirements.acceptance: Render a routed card and correlate its acknowledgment; hidden, locked, disconnected and stale pages cannot report a successful current render.

requirements.requirement: A native macOS client implements the common surface contract with truthful audio, rendering, permissions, lock/sleep and availability constraints.
requirements.acceptance: Required product deliverable: verify native lifecycle, playback stop, local confirmation, protected credential storage and installable packaging; no competing assistant authority. Completion is separate from the first verified Cosmos/Center server rollout.

requirements.requirement: A native Android companion declares real foreground/background, audio, notification, permission and reconnect behavior through the common surface contract.
requirements.acceptance: Required product deliverable: verify foreground/background permissions, reconnect, protected credential storage and installable packaging on a physical phone; notification delivery is not render acknowledgment or microphone permission. Completion is separate from the first verified Cosmos/Center server rollout.

requirements.requirement: A thin Linux client supports the owner's Omarchy PC through the same approved surface and room contract.
requirements.acceptance: Verify the installed desktop/compositor, local microphone and screen-sharing permission flow, lock/sleep, playback stop, protected credential storage, reconnect and installable packaging. Browser access does not establish native Linux support.

requirements.requirement: A thin Android TV client on the owner's NVIDIA Shield 4K TV Pro provides permitted, origin-bound playback context for questions through the Ai Pin.
requirements.acceptance: Verify owner-enabled media access and actual YouTube, Stremio, TV2 Play, Netflix and Spotify behavior. Preserve absent, stale and ambiguous metadata; a title and position are not scene evidence. Respect secure capture and provider restrictions, including Spotify AI-ingestion and voice-assistant limits. Test session changes, ads/live streams, competing players, permissions, sleep and reconnect on hardware.

requirements.requirement: Deploy only the authenticated tagged operator release and matching verified five-APK set; retain stock wire/package identities and require physical acceptance for changed Pin behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Run focused and broad checks, production doctor/dry-run/deploy/verify, then confirm the intended release and production environment at the existing https://center.andersmadsen.dk/ origin. No new domain or identity migration is requested. Metadata tests or endpoint health alone cannot establish Ambiance conformance.
